RE: Account reference: ACC-856157

Dear Mr. Young,

Receiving your dispute letter regarding the account ACC-856157, we acknowledge your request for validation of the debt. We understand that you have disputed the debt with Medical Data Systems, claiming you do not have a contract with them and did not receive the original as requested.

We have reviewed the account information and confirmed that the original creditor is indeed Cornerstone Community Bank. The current balance of the account is $11,623.72. We have also verified that the charge-off date was December 5, 2024, and the last payment date was January 24, 2024.

As per the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), we are required to provide you with validation of the debt upon your request. We will send you a validation notice within the next 30 days, which will include information about the debt, including the original creditor, the amount owed, and the reason for the charge-off.

Please note that you have the right to dispute this debt further if you believe it is inaccurate or invalid. If we do not receive a response from you, we will consider this matter closed.

Sincerely,

Bridgeport Recovery Inc.
